content: I have 5 nested summations, but docs#Finset.sum_comm and docs#Finset.sum_comm_cycle only allow me to cycle the first 2 or 3 summations, respectively. Is there a way to use push and/or pull to re-arrange an arbitrary number of nested summations or else be able to re-arrange the sums past the first 3?
You could use conv to move inside the sums you don't want to rearrange, and then iterate with sum_comm to swap one at a time
